placements.reason: Delivery and durable acceptance are separate accepted states.
Manual release is the accepted baseline policy, not an implementation detail.
Release is blocked until required local replicas are durably verified.
Registry status alone has no deletion or release authority in the current baseline.
The accepted safe publication protocol permits one automatic create attempt for one logical attempt.
An ambiguous create outcome must be reconciled by reads and never authorizes a second automatic POST.
A marker match alone is insufficient; recovered remote evidence must be fully verified.
Registry is an upstream authority and Cabinet does not mutate it.
Registry observations may change validation/review state but never rewrite an immutable Card.
Plan/actual calculation may consume only confirmed matching decisions.
Analysis produces derived evidence and must not rewrite source facts.
The accepted product boundary is photographs and PDF originals only.
Declared media type and extension are insufficient acceptance evidence.
Untrusted boundary metadata never establishes content acceptance.
Every source boundary requires the accepted finite configured size limit.
Parsing and preview must operate under bounded resources.
The accepted boundary limits each uploaded source file to 50 MiB; the value is deployment configuration rather than durable_archive module state.
StoredInvoiceCard is a persisted mutable archive identity and therefore local master state.
Accepted Card revisions are immutable persisted records; correction creates a new record.
Validation records are immutable decision evidence and append rather than update.
Duplicate review has a mutable explicit decision lifecycle owned locally.
SourceBinary has a stable content identity with locally mutable availability and retention state.
Replica location and verification state form a mutable persisted local lifecycle.
Catalogue publication is locally owned mutable delivery lifecycle state.
Replica availability and retention state are mutable persisted local state.
WorkObject is Cabinet-owned mutable working projection keyed by Registry project identity.
Assignment observations are immutable provenance evidence tied to exact Card revisions.
Assignment validation is immutable decision evidence; later checks create new records.
Transfer manifests are immutable descriptions identified by exact package content.
Synchronization is a mutable transport lifecycle whose knowledge changes over time.
Import is a mutable local acceptance lifecycle through validation/quarantine/acceptance.
Quarantine is a mutable explicit exception-resolution lifecycle.
Transfer receipts are immutable settled outcome evidence; reconciliation appends superseding evidence.
Working replica availability is mutable persisted node state.
Synchronization conflicts persist as mutable explicit-resolution lifecycles.
Confirmed/rejected matching is a mutable Cabinet decision lifecycle.
Logical Holded publication is mutable business lifecycle state owned by Cabinet.
Technical gateway attempts are immutable audit evidence; each retry is a new attempt.
Explicit incomplete-source acceptance is immutable auditable decision evidence.
Source-loss decisions are immutable audit history retained after later recovery.
